question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vigilant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e., 'Careless'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vigilant"** means keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. (सतर्क)

 
 
• **Example:** The security guard remained vigilant throughout the night to ensure safety.
 
 
 
• **"Careless"** refers to not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors. (लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example:** His careless driving resulted in a minor accident.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'vigilant'** is **'careless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Careless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Awake** (जागृत): Not asleep.

 
 
• **Example:** He stayed awake all night to finish his project.
 
 
 
• **Choosy** (चूजी): Overly particular or fastidious in making a choice.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very choosy about what she eats.
 
 
 
• **Mindful** (ध्यानशील): Conscious or aware of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Be mindful of how you speak to others.
